title: 运动鞋使用证据｜涉水步态、路面压力与产品英雄镜头
source_title: 雨夜跑鞋广告｜湿地行进到鞋底微距与成对落版
summary: 先让明确成年使用者在湿滑路线中提出需求，再用鞋底、鞋面和落地压力的微距逐项证明；完整产品始终可辨，最终回到单只与成对产品英雄镜头。
input_format: Establish one original product through macro material anchors before showing the complete object. + Connect at least two visible ingredient or design details to one coherent environment identity. + Use one functional product action as the sole optical transition into the environment. + Expand the environment, then enclose its recognizable geometry inside one transparent carrier. + Return the carrier and environment to the same complete product with stable shape, label-free identity and hero proof.
recommended_input: 成年夜班急救员穿原创白蓝救援靴，穿过雨湿仓库地面。；三次微距依次证明排水纹路、密封接缝和受控鞋底压缩。；成对产品与湿地路线同场停留，三个功能证据同时可辨。
required_anchors: Use context establishes the product need before macros.
One product geometry remains recognizable throughout.
Adult movement visibly exercises those functions.
The final hero frame reunites product, route and proof.
